research_mode: official Building Safety Regulator and GOV.UK primary guidance only; complaints, resident escalation, golden-thread information and key-building-information methodology gates; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Key information for each structure
verified_claims: Registration asks for structure and fire-safety information for each structure where a building has more than one structure.
limitations: Structure boundaries must be determined from building-specific evidence.

sources.name: Reasonable steps to obtain KBI
verified_claims: The PAP should take all reasonable steps to find the requested key building information.
limitations: Reasonable steps do not guarantee that every field is known.

sources.name: Existing records as KBI sources
verified_claims: Recent fire-risk assessments, external-wall appraisals and maintenance or inspection records may contain key building information.
limitations: Existing records may be outdated, incomplete or outside their original scope.

sources.name: Current-state reporting
verified_claims: KBI should describe the building as it is now or at the most recent survey, not planned changes or improvements.
limitations: The most recent survey date and subsequent changes must be checked.

sources.name: KBI 28-day submission
verified_claims: Detailed structure and fire-safety information must be provided within 28 days after the registration application.
limitations: A deadline does not prove that the submitted information was timely or accurate.

sources.name: Residential evacuation strategy
verified_claims: KBI asks for the evacuation strategy for residential areas, with options including phased, progressive horizontal, simultaneous, stay put and temporary simultaneous.
limitations: A selected strategy must not be treated as suitable without the building's fire-risk context.

sources.name: Temporary-strategy update
verified_claims: A temporary simultaneous strategy requires a later update when the strategy changes.
limitations: Temporary status does not establish when or whether the change occurred.

sources.name: Residential-unit fire equipment
verified_claims: KBI asks whether residential units contain heat detectors, smoke detectors, sprinklers or misters, with an option for none or inaccessible units.
limitations: An inaccessible-unit response must not be interpreted as confirmed absence of equipment.

sources.name: Shared-part fire equipment
verified_claims: KBI asks about specified alarms, dampers, extinguishers, shutters, detectors, risers, smoke controls and sprinklers in shared parts.
limitations: The listed categories are not a complete inventory or a condition assessment.

sources.name: Fire-equipment locations
verified_claims: For most reported fire and smoke equipment, KBI asks for locations such as basements, corridors, staircases, lobbies and rooftops.
limitations: A reported location does not verify operation, coverage or maintenance condition.

sources.name: Fire and evacuation lift types
verified_claims: KBI distinguishes evacuation lifts, firefighters lifts and fire-fighting lifts using their functions and applicable standards.
limitations: A marketing label or ordinary passenger lift must not be assigned a protected lift class without evidence.

sources.name: Fire-door resistance counts
verified_claims: KBI asks for counts of residential front doors and common-part fire doors by certified resistance duration, including unknown classifications.
limitations: A certification category does not establish present door condition or installation quality.

sources.name: Building energy storage
verified_claims: KBI asks about site energy storage such as hydrogen or lithium-ion batteries, excluding storage that supplies individual residents' equipment.
limitations: The listed options are not a complete hazard inventory and do not establish condition.

sources.name: Energy generation and supply
verified_claims: KBI asks about on-site generation and building energy supplies, including heat pumps, biomass, solar or wind, communal heating, electricity, gas and oil.
limitations: Presence of an energy system does not establish safety, capacity or compliance.

sources.name: External-wall and major-work information
verified_claims: KBI asks about visible external-wall materials and specified building works such as cladding, cavity barriers, added floors, rewiring and changes to fire systems.
limitations: Reported materials or works require source records and must not be inferred from imagery or age alone.
